notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 101 from 17 April 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/1CJQuqM89I7hWA9KYvjCop?si=arncPmZ1SseRp6Atuf1ilw) with @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects. First-choice PvE pick for Minor Spec add clearing in end-game content. If you find a roll you like, keep for the ability to enhance perks when Final Shape arrives. The Prophet is the first stasis aggressive frame scout rifle and while it has good stats it's not a very competitive subtype for PvE unfortunately. It's got a bit of a kick so, even on M+KB you might benefit from boosted stability with the barrel and mag perks. The trait perks are a bit underwhelming too - Rapid Hit is probably best in the first column, with Demolitionist and possibly Keep Away also useful for the reload boost. In the second column, Explosive Payload is, again, probably best or Precision Instrument can be okay if you're hitting your headshots. Of the origin traits, Alacrity is best if you're running solo, in endgame activities to help clutch when everyone else is dead, or One Quiet Moment can be useful when in cover. Recommended MW: Stability, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

First-choice PvE pick for Minor Spec add clearing in end-game content, particularly with a Stasis subclass. If you find a roll you like, keep for the ability to enhance perks when Final Shape arrives. The Prophet is the first stasis aggressive frame scout rifle and while it has good stats it's not a very competitive subtype for PvE unfortunately. It's got a bit of a kick so, even on M+KB you might benefit from boosted stability with the barrel and mag perks. The trait perks are a bit underwhelming too - Rapid Hit is probably best in the first column, with Demolitionist and possibly Keep Away also useful for the reload boost. In the second column, you should be able to create Stasis crystals easily enough, to synergise with the subclass fragments, but they'll be a long way away! Of the origin traits, Alacrity is best if you're running solo, in endgame activities to help clutch when everyone else is dead, or One Quiet Moment can be useful when in cover. Recommended MW: Stability, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "New DMT-lite? Heck yeah. Let’s Yee to the Haw. Keep Away will benefit your accuracy and reload speed which will help alleviate the necessity of reloader gauntlets. Do I recommend foregoing it entirely? No but you can stack enough reload through your masterwork, Keep Away, and Tactical Mag or Flared Magwell to not need it. Precision Instrument will be great as the reload will allow you to keep up high stacks. Headstone works will being a scout and a high-damage frame." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "The Prophet in PvP doesn’t really handle like a legendary DMT; more like a long ranged 120 hand cannon. Precision Instrument will make the 2c1b a little easier, but Kill Clip will be the most sought after perk for being able to 2c any resilience guardian. 120 hand cannons lost this ability so if you’re looking for a replacement, this is it." Recommended MW: Stability.
